title: Hampi
subtitle: Vijayanagara Ruins · Temple Architecture · Heritage
inclusions: Mumbai to Hampi AC Bus Tickets (both ways)

travel.departure: Borivali — 2:00 PM, 05 Nov | Multiple pickup points across Mumbai

itinerary.title: Board Bus from Mumbai
itinerary.description: Boarding points: Borivali (2:00 PM), Sion (3:00 PM), Nerul LP (4:00 PM), Kalamboli MCD (5:00 PM), Wakad Bridge (7:30 PM), Navale Bridge (9:00 PM). Arrive 15 minutes before departure. Overnight bus journey towards Hosapete.

itinerary.title: Hampi Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Reach Hosapete by approximately 6:00 AM. Freshen up in common dormitory rooms. Breakfast. Sightseeing: Underground Shiva Temple, Lotus Mahal, Elephant Stable, Queen's Bath Complex, Monolithic Nandi. Check into hotel. Dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Hampi Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Breakfast. Visit Kondaram Temple, Sugreev Caves, King's Balance, Stone Chariot, and Vijay Vitthal Temple. Evening: Coracle Ride (at own expense). Shopping in Hampi streets. Return to hotel. Dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Hampi Sightseeing + Return
itinerary.description: Breakfast. Visit Virupaksha Temple, Kadalekalu Ganesha, Sasivekalu Ganesha, Badavalinga Temple, and Ugra Narasimha Temple. After sightseeing, board bus for return journey to Mumbai.

itinerary.title: Reach Mumbai
itinerary.description: Reach Mumbai by approximately 7:00 AM. Return home with sweet memories!
